CREATE PROCEDURE CDN.SrtRodzice @GIDNumer int AS BEGIN DECLARE @n INT DECLARE @prevcount INT DECLARE @count INT
SET @count=-1 SET @prevcount=0
CREATE TABLE #tmpnumery(GN INT,C INT) INSERT INTO #tmpnumery VALUES(@GIDNumer,1) WHILE (@prevcount!=@count) --przechodzenie grafu wszerz, jezeli nic nie dodano konczymy BEGIN INSERT INTO #tmpnumery SELECT DISTINCT SrG_GRONumer,0 FROM CDN.SrtGrupy WHERE SrG_GIDNumer IN(SELECT GN FROM #tmpnumery) AND SrG_GIDTyp=-368 AND SrG_GIDNumer > 0 AND SrG_GRONumer NOT IN (SELECT GN FROM #tmpnumery) SET @prevcount=@count SET @count=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #tmpnumery) END SET @prevcount=0 SET @count=-1 WHILE (@prevcount!=@count) BEGIN DECLARE c CURSOR FOR SELECT GN FROM #tmpnumery OPEN c FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @n FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @n --pomijamy pierwszy rekord - dla niego C=1 IF (@count=-1) SET @count=0 WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN UPDATE #tmpnumery --podliczanie ilosci mozliwych sciezek jako sumy ilosci na elementach prowadzacych do elementu SET C=(SELECT SUM(C) FROM #tmpnumery WHERE GN IN (SELECT SrG_GIDNumer FROM CDN.SrtGrupy WHERE SrG_GRONumer=@n AND SrG_GIDTyp=-368 AND SrG_GIDNumer > 0 )) WHERE GN=@n SET @prevcount=@count SET @count=(SELECT SUM(C) FROM #tmpnumery) FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @n END CLOSE c DEALLOCATE c END SELECT * FROM #tmpnumery END
